The activity was conducted through the online channel in billing region 315.0. The activity matches no documented typology in the issuer's manual and is described in the accompanying case record. The same origin appears on 27 other card(s) belonging to unrelated customers within the same window, including C01289-K2, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, indicating a common actor across multiple cardholders rather than an isolated compromise.
